verses.1: After that, I saw that a door had been opened in the sky. The first voice I heard was like a bird singing along with me, saying, “Go ahead, and I will show you what must happen.”
verses.2: I immediately became part of the spirit. And I saw that the throne was in heaven. And as I sat on that throne,
verses.3: And the person sitting there will see stones that look like sticks and branches. And from the center of the throne, he will see something that looks like a dark green color.
verses.4: And from the circular structure of the throne, there were twenty-four thrones. And on those thrones sat twenty-four priests, dressed in white robes. On their heads, they wore golden crowns.
verses.5: And from the throne, flames, voices, and thunderous sounds are sent out. There are also seven flames of fire placed in front of the throne. These seven flames represent the seven spirits of God.
verses.6: And in front of the throne, it was covered with a pale blue crystal, resembling a sea. In the middle of the throne and around its circumference, there were four animals, each with eyes on the front and back sides.
verses.7: And the first animal resembled a lion, the second animal resembled a fox, the third animal had a face similar to a human’s, and the fourth animal resembled an eagle in its flight.
verses.8: And the four animals also have four wings, with each wing serving as a pair of wings. They fill our eyes from both inside and outside. They don’t rest either day or night. Holy, holy, holy Lord! The God, the Almighty, who exists and will continue to exist forever.
verses.9: And when they give the animals honor, respect, and thanksgiving to the one who sits on the throne, to that living being who exists throughout all ages.
verses.10: The forty-six oldest men shall fall before the one who sits on the throne. They will worship the living one for all ages to come. They will also place their crowns before the throne, saying:
verses.11: It is right, O Lord and God of us all, that you should receive glory, honor, and power. For it was because of your will that everything was created and came into being.
